svg.title: Full-checker passes by cohort and ship size
svg.desc: held-out maps, frozen pipeline, run after two interrupted attempts; not the pre-registered sealed claim. Two earlier attempts on the same maps stopped early when our own frozen-code guard tripped. In the first, a test rewrote a pinned fixture; in the second, the engine wrote scratch files inside its pinned folder. No planning code changed. They completed 36 and 91 rows; both are published as they are and not pooled with the final run. Where the same rows ran again in the final run, attempt 1 matched the final run on 36 of the 38 rows it opened (status and lifts; 37 of 38 on verdict alone) and attempt 2 on 91 of 91, reported separately.
svg.text: Full-checker passes by cohort and ship size
held-out maps, frozen pipeline, run after two interrupted attempts; not the pre-registered sealed claim
Synthetic ships and cargo, simulated port · planning step from a clean load list
Templated sentences · frozen standard profile · frozen pipeline v3 (a11b4202…)
Summary of the two envelope rows above
Dots / squares show observed rates; bars show exact two-sided Clopper–Pearson 95% intervals from the report.
Pass means L0: full checker, completion, every confirmed instruction obeyed. Relaxed plans are not passes.
Two-step: a simple two-step planner, modelled from one field expert's description. No like-for-like lift comparison is available.
Envelope: up to 195 boxes in a half-ship section of 500–800 TEU feeder ships, at most 70% of that section; empty section on arrival, one loading
call. Other bays hold fixed synthetic cargo.
1,700 TEU test maps are outside this envelope wording. Cohorts are separate; no tiny/small maps are pooled with the envelope.
Two earlier attempts on the same maps stopped early when our own frozen-code guard tripped. In the first, a test rewrote a pinned fixture; in the
second, the engine wrote scratch files inside its pinned folder. No planning code changed. They completed 36 and 91 rows; both are published as
they are and not pooled with the final run. Where the same rows ran again in the final run, attempt 1 matched the final run on 36 of the 38 rows
it opened (status and lifts; 37 of 38 on verdict alone) and attempt 2 on 91 of 91, reported separately.
Source: final-3/report.json and story-figures.json · recorded results only; no planning rerun
